definitions.explanation: Effort made with difficulty or mental struggle. The process of working hard on something challenging.

examples.japanese: {苦心|くしん}の{末|すえ}、ついに{完成|かんせい}した。
examples.english: After much effort, it was finally completed.
examples.notes: [Note: 苦心の末 = after great pains]

examples.japanese: この{作品|さくひん}には{作者|さくしゃ}の{苦心|くしん}が{感|かん}じられる。
examples.english: You can feel the author's painstaking effort in this work.

examples.japanese: {資金|しきん}{調達|ちょうたつ}に{苦心|くしん}している。

notes:
PATTERNS:
・{苦心|くしん}する (to take pains, to struggle)
・{苦心|くしん}の{末|すえ} (after great effort)
・{苦心|くしん}の{作|さく} (a work made with great effort)
・{苦心|くしん}を{重|かさ}ねる (to make repeated efforts)
・{苦心|くしん}{惨憺|さんたん} (working one's fingers to the bone)

COMPOUNDS:
・{苦心談|くしんだん} (story of one's struggles/efforts)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{苦労|くろう} (hardship, trouble)
・{努力|どりょく} (effort - more positive)
・{工夫|くふう} (ingenuity, device)

NOTE: {苦心|くしん} emphasizes the mental struggle and painstaking nature of effort, while {努力|どりょく} is more neutral.
